request.description: A tiny pixel-art VFX sprite sheet on a transparent 32x32 canvas. Sparse drifting snow flecks and cold glints for a snowy mountain game. Four isolated little motifs arranged in a 2 by 2 grid with lots of empty transparent space: top left a single tiny round snow mote, top right a small diagonal 3-pixel snow fleck, bottom left a tiny irregular diamond snowflake, bottom right one very simple four-point ice sparkle. Each motif only 3 to 7 native pixels across, centered in its own 16x16 quadrant, no touching or connecting. Only white, pale icy blue and muted blue-gray. Hard pixels, economical clusters, no outline, no gradients, no glow halo, no blur, no background, no text, no scene, no large snowflake icon. Small understated reusable ambient effects, clean whimsical fantasy game style.
